movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Right plucking hand strikes the dombra strings while fingers and wrists flex upward to pull the puppet's attached strings; expert players incorporate left-hand or foot string tethers.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Stationary seated stage performance focused on a small tabletop or drumhead area.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Musician's torso remains relatively steady to anchor the lute and provide leverage for the puppet's string mechanisms.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: The wooden puppet performs continuous small hops, vertical leaps, and landing strikes upon the drumhead.
movement_profile.partnering: Solo performance; partnering exists purely between human musician and mechanical puppet.
movement_profile.posture: Musician sits upright or cross-legged, holding the dombra steady while arms and hands maintain precise tension over the puppet's connecting cords.

signature_moves.description: The rapid jumping and hopping of the puppet across the drum skin driven by finger plucking gestures.
signature_moves.name: goat leaping

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Energetic, agile, and syncopated, reflecting the startled jumps of a trapped mountain goat.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid slackening the control cords, which disrupts the simultaneous rhythm between the dombra notes and the drum taps.

music_profile.sound_description: A rapid, resonant plucked lute melody played on the two strings of the dombra, accented by the sharp, intermittent woody clatter and dull tapping of the marionette's hooves landing upon the skin of a dauylpaz drum, occasionally supplemented by the high whistle of the sazsyrnay or the buzzing hum of the shankobyz.
music_profile.vocal_style: instrumental only (dialogues and singing are absent)

basic_steps: not described in sources (performer is seated and manipulates puppet through stringed finger strokes)
teaching.formation: Solo instrumentalist seated behind a low table or drum support facing the audience.
teaching.level_notes: Mastery requires simultaneous competence in rapid two-stringed dombra fingerwork and kinetic coordination of tension strings controlling the puppet.
teaching.rhythm: Rhythmic accompaniment driven by the plucking pattern of the dombra and the tapping hoofbeats of the puppet upon the dauylpaz drum head.
